By using CallGuard you agree to these terms.

CallGuard checks incoming calls against the numbers you choose to allow (your whitelist) and, on the Plus and Pro plans, against your device contacts. This check happens only on your device.

CallGuard cannot guarantee that every unwanted call is blocked or that every wanted call gets through; you are responsible for reviewing your whitelist and settings.

Plans: Free, Plus and Pro. Plus and Pro are sold through Google Play as monthly or yearly subscriptions; Plus is also available as a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel them in Google Play; after canceling, the plan stays active until the end of the period already paid. Prices, trials and refunds follow Google Play's terms.

If a plan ends, every number already in your whitelist keeps being allowed. Features of the higher plan stop, and the call history keeps only what the current plan allows (7 days on Free, 90 on Plus, 365 on Pro).

You can stop using CallGuard and uninstall it at any time, which also removes the data stored on your device.

These terms may be updated as the app evolves.
Understand how your data and permissions are handled.

CallGuard is built to keep your data on your device.

What we access: the number of each incoming call, only to decide whether to allow or block it, and, on the Plus and Pro plans and with your permission, your device contacts, to allow people you already know. None of this leaves your device or is sent to us or to third parties.

What we store: your whitelist, the call decision history and your settings are saved in the app's private storage. The history is kept for 7 days on Free, 90 on Plus and 365 on Pro, then deleted automatically. Uninstalling the app deletes all of it.

Backup: you can export your whitelist and settings (and, if you choose, the call history) to a password-protected file saved only where you choose. CallGuard never receives this file.

Payments: Google Play processes purchases; the app only receives which plan is active, never your payment details.

No ads, no analytics, no tracking: CallGuard includes no advertising or analytics SDKs and does not sell or share your data.

This policy may be updated as the app evolves.
